title: Q-Leap commits to inclusion and diversity by taking part in DuoDay 2024
excerpt: We are delighted to announce that Q-Leap is taking part in the DuoDay organized by Adem this Thursday, November 21, 2024. DuoDay is a European initiative to promote the inclusion of people with disabilities in the world of work. For one day, a person with a disability forms a “duo” with a professional within a company or organization. This tandem enables the person to discover a profession, acquire new skills and consider career prospects.
description: Alexis Leclercq joins Q-Leap, our team of testers, as Technical Test Consultant, expert in automation!
